decides: 主体的身份与形体契约——年龄、体格、服饰逻辑、气质，观众先认出「这是什么角色」

items.prompt: shonen hero protagonist, teenage build with slightly oversized expressive eyes, windswept hair with deliberate spike clusters, determination readable in brow and jaw, practical adventure clothing with worn edges
items.note: 头身比与眼神是年龄感的锚

items.prompt: shoujo heroine protagonist, slender figure with large luminous eyes carrying multiple highlight shapes, finely detailed hair with soft gradient ends, layered skirt and ribbon construction, gentle posture with one hand near the collarbone
items.note: 高光形状数量决定「闪度」

items.prompt: cool composed mature woman, sharp narrowed eyes with heavy upper lid line, long straight hair with a single accent strand, tailored silhouette with clean vertical folds, relaxed but guarded stance
items.note: 气场靠眼型与垂直线，不靠化妆

items.prompt: energetic kouhai junior, bouncy twin tails or short bob with motion sweep, bright wide eyes and open-mouthed grin, slightly loose uniform with rolled sleeves, mid-gesture pose with forward lean
items.note: 动感来自发型轨迹与身体前倾

items.prompt: wise elderly mentor, deeply lined face with kind procedural eyebrows, long beard or topknot with silver-to-white gradient, layered robes with weighty drape, staff or scroll held loose in one hand
items.note: 皱纹走向要服从表情，不是均匀网格

items.prompt: rival antagonist, angular face with asymmetric hair and one sharp canines showing, high-collared cape or coat with dramatic interior lining, half-lidded confident eyes, stance occupying more space than needed
items.note: 反派构图占位要超出必要，才有压迫感

items.prompt: mecha pilot, tight-fitting plugsuit with seam lines and helmet under one arm, short practical hair with sweat at the temple, youthful face carrying unusual composure, harness straps over the chest
items.note: 驾驶服是第二层皮肤，不是紧身衣

items.prompt: staff-wielding mage, long layered robe with celestial pattern trim, pointed hat or hood with deep shadow over the eyes, both hands on a carved wooden staff with a glowing focal gem, floating runes orbiting the shaft
items.note: 法力可视化：光从法杖焦点溢出

items.prompt: elven figure, elongated ears with delicate vein suggestion, ethereal features with slightly large eyes, nature-motif jewelry and leaf-shaped cloak clasps, forest-toned palette with bioluminescent accents, weightless posture
items.note: 尖耳只是入口，气质要轻

items.prompt: beast companion creature, anthropomorphic animal with correct quadruped-to-biped joint logic, fur direction following muscle masses, expressive ears and tail communicating mood, simple harness or scarf as the only clothing
items.note: 关节逻辑错了，萌度归零

items.prompt: android figure, synthetic skin panels with subtle seam lines at joints, one glowing optical sensor or visor, mechanical hand with visible articulation cables, synthetic hair with unnatural uniformity, posture slightly too precise to be human
items.note: 太完美本身就是非人信号

items.prompt: fairy pet mascot, palm-sized round body with oversized head and tiny translucent wings, dust-trail sparkle behind, enormous pleading eyes with catchlights, one accessory like a leaf hat or bell collar
items.note: 吉祥物的剪影要能在图标尺寸存活

items.prompt: swordsman figure, topknot with a trailing headband strand, dark indigo hakama with tied obi, iaijutsu ready stance with knees softly bent and weight low, blade held with correct grip geometry
items.note: 重心压低才有「静中的紧绷」

items.prompt: idol singer, stage costume with layered frills and gem clips, microphone held with correct hand shape, twin-tail or long wave hair catching stage light, wide sparkling eyes and an open singing mouth, confetti and light beams behind
items.note: 握麦手势错一点，整张图就假

items.prompt: scientist researcher, lab coat over casual clothes with a pocket protector and safety goggles pushed up on the forehead, chalk dust on the sleeves, eager slightly unfocused expression, clipboard or flask in hand
items.note: 白大褂的褶皱要像穿过很多次

items.prompt: masked mysterious figure, smooth featureless mask or Noh-like carved expression mask, wide sleeves hiding the hands, no readable body language, still posture at the frame edge, one patterned obi as the only color accent
items.note: 不可读是角色本身，构图要给悬念让位
